overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of South Carolina Aiken women's polo team for winning the 2026 United States Polo Association Division I Women's National Intercollegiate Championship. The team beat Texas A&M University 15 to 6 on March 22, 2026, earning the program's first national title and capping its first undefeated season. The resolution recognizes the players, coaches and staff, and asks that official copies be sent to three team members. It does not change any law or spending. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on April 27, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting way to recognize student athletes and a small public university for a historic, undefeated championship season.
against: Critics say the resolution is purely ceremonial and doesn't change any law or spending.
